name: @transcend-io/mcp

tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: List or full-text search Transcend documentation. With query, ranks articles by title and body and returns snippets; with section alone, lists that section; with neither, returns the section names. Pick the best matching url, then call docs_fetch.

section.description: List the articles in this llms.txt section (exact match). Omit both arguments to see the available section names.

query.description: Full-text search terms. Prefer the two or three most distinctive words for the topic over a whole sentence, since common words match most articles and blur the ranking. At most 20 results come back and there is no paging, so narrow the terms rather than expecting to page.

tools.name: docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch full markdown content for a Transcend documentation article by URL. Use urls returned by docs_list.

url.description: Absolute https URL of a docs.transcend.io article (.md) from docs_list.

tools.name: dsr_submit
tools.description: Submit a Data Subject Request via customer-ingress REST bulk create (`POST /v1/data-subject-request-bulk`). Call `workflows_list` first and pass a returned `id` as `workflowConfigId` — type and subjectType are derived from that workflow (do not invent them). Sombra attests the subject from the provided email/identifiers. coreIdentifier defaults to email. Returns a minimal summary for each created request. Requires Sombra (SOMBRA_URL or organization customerUrl).

workflowConfigId.description: UUID of the published workflow config (Privacy Requests → Workflows, or workflows_list). Request type and subject class are derived from this config — do not pass type/subjectType.

email.description: Email address of the data subject

coreIdentifier.description: Core identifier for the data subject (defaults to email if not provided)

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: dsr_poll_status
tools.description: Poll the current status of a Data Subject Request

requestId.description: ID of the DSR to check

tools.name: dsr_list
tools.description: List Data Subject Requests with assigned owners and teams. Filter by identifierValue to look up requests by email or phone (fuzzy/exact across request identifiers, same as admin "Identifier Value (Fuzzy)"). Use emails only for exact match on primary email address. Note: Server-side date filtering is not available — filter results client-side if needed. For per-system failures and system owners, use dsr_list_request_data_silos on a specific request.

cursor.description: Continuation token from the previous response.

identifierValue.description: Fuzzy/exact search across request identifiers (email, phone, etc.). Prefer this for looking up DSRs by email or phone. Maps to admin "Identifier Value (Fuzzy)".

emails.description: Exact match on primary email address only. Does not search phone or other identifiers — use identifierValue for those.

tools.name: dsr_get_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Data Subject Request, including assigned request owners (individual assignees), teams, and request enrichers (enricher.id for dsr_enrich_identifiers without a nonce). For connected system status, failures, and system owners, use dsr_list_request_data_silos.

requestId.description: ID of the DSR to retrieve

tools.name: dsr_list_identifiers
tools.description: List decrypted identifiers attached to a Data Subject Request.

tools.name: dsr_list_request_data_silos
tools.description: List connected data systems (request data silos) for a Data Subject Request, including each system's processing status, error message when failed, and the responsible system owners and teams. Use this to diagnose approval or compilation bottlenecks caused by failed or stalled systems. Filter with status=["ERROR"] for failures.

requestId.description: ID of the Data Subject Request whose connected systems to list

status.description: Optional filter by request-data-silo status values (e.g. ERROR, RESOLVED, WAITING, ACTION_REQUIRED). Use ERROR to find failed systems.

visualStatus.description: Optional filter by a single visual status, including WAITING_ON_DEPENDENCIES, DATA_SILO_DISCONNECTED, DATA_SILO_PAUSED, MANUAL, etc.

text.description: Optional free-text filter on the connected data silo title

tools.name: dsr_list_pending_requests
tools.description: List outstanding ACCESS or ERASURE jobs waiting on one data silo (integration), oldest first. Each item carries the requestId, the identifier to process, and the Sombra-signed nonce that dsr_enrich_identifiers requires for that job. Requires Sombra and a Transcend API key linked to this data silo; OAuth-only auth returns 401.

dataSiloId.description: UUID of the data silo whose pending jobs to list (from dsr_list_request_data_silos or inventory). The authenticated Transcend API key MUST be associated with this same data silo (Admin → Developer → API Keys → linked Data Silos). Do not pass a silo the key is not linked to.

requestType.description: Pending job type: ACCESS (fulfillment) or ERASURE (fulfillment)

tools.name: dsr_enrich_identifiers
tools.description: Enrich a Data Subject Request with additional identifiers during preflight. Prefer a nonce from dsr_list_pending_requests (enrichment stage) or the webhook. Alternate with no nonce: pass requestId + enricherId (official enrich-only header path). Access/erasure respond tools still require a real fulfillment nonce. Requires Sombra. Listing pending jobs needs a Transcend API key associated with that data silo (not OAuth-only).

nonce.description: Preferred: Sombra-signed JWT from dsr_list_pending_requests item.nonce for the enrichment stage (or webhook x-transcend-nonce). Never invent; never use encryptedCekContext.

requestId.description: Alternate (no nonce): privacy request ID together with enricherId (sent as x-transcend-request-id). Respond paths still need a real nonce.

enricherId.description: Alternate (no nonce): enricher ID together with requestId (sent as x-transcend-enricher-id). Discover via dsr_get_details → requestEnrichers[].enricher.id.

identifiers.description: Key-value pairs of identifier names and values to add

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: dsr_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a Data Subject Request

requestId.description: ID of the DSR to cancel

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: dsr_analyze
tools.description: Summarize the 100 most recent DSRs: counts by type and status, completion rate, and a configurable recent-days window (default 30). For full-fleet analytics, page through dsr_list and aggregate yourself.

days.description: Filter analysis to requests within N days (default: 30). Only analyzes from the 100 most recent requests.

tools.name: consent_get_preferences
tools.description: Get consent preferences for a specific user/identifier

tools.name: consent_list_purposes
tools.description: List all tracking purposes configured for consent management.

tools.name: consent_list_data_flows
tools.description: List data flows (network requests) in your consent manager. Requires status: NEEDS_REVIEW (triage) or LIVE (approved). Returns value (URL/host), service, purposes, occurrences. Filter via unmappedOnly, type, trackingTypes, minOccurrences, lastDiscoveredAtBefore/After.

status.description: Filter by status: NEEDS_REVIEW (triage) or LIVE (approved)

showZeroActivity.description: Include zero-activity flows. Omit so NEEDS_REVIEW totals match consent_get_inventory_stats; set true for the full never-active backlog.

unmappedOnly.description: Only unmapped flows (no service). Useful with status=LIVE for approved orphans.

type.description: Filter by data flow scope type (e.g. HOST, PATH, REGEX, CSP)

tools.name: consent_list_cookies
tools.description: List cookies in your consent manager. Requires status: NEEDS_REVIEW (triage) or LIVE (approved). Returns name, service, purposes, occurrences, junk status. Filter via trackingPurposes, lastDiscoveredAtBefore/After, minOccurrences, orderField.

status.description: Filter by status: NEEDS_REVIEW (triage) or LIVE (approved)

showZeroActivity.description: Include zero-activity cookies. Omit so NEEDS_REVIEW totals match consent_get_inventory_stats; set true for the full never-active backlog.

orderDirection.description: Sort direction when orderField is set.

tools.name: consent_list_airgap_bundles
tools.description: Get the consent manager (airgap bundle) configured for your organization. Returns the bundle ID, URLs, configuration, and domains.

tools.name: consent_list_regimes
tools.description: List all consent experiences (regional regimes) configured for your organization. Returns experience name, regions, purposes, opted-out purposes, and view state.

tools.name: consent_get_inventory_stats
tools.description: Get cookie and data-flow inventory triage counts: live (approved), needs review, and junk. Counts match the Consent Manager tables and the default consent_list_cookies / consent_list_data_flows filters (CSP data flows are omitted, same as the UI). This is inventory status, not consent analytics — use consent_get_aggregate_analytics or consent_get_timeseries_analytics for opt-in/out and signal metrics.

tools.name: consent_cookie_triage_review_app
tools.description: Opens an interactive consent triage review UI for cookies or data flows. Pass triageType ("cookies" | "data_flows"). On MCP App hosts the tool returns a fast shell and the view pages consent_list_cookies or consent_list_data_flows; elsewhere the tool fetches the organization name and items (pages of 100, cap ~600), groups by purpose (≤100/tab), and sorts by traffic. No agent classification suggestions. Use the consent-triage prompt for the full workflow.

triageType.description: Open the review UI for cookies or data flows that need review

tools.name: consent_get_aggregate_analytics
tools.description: Query aggregate consent analytics via airgapBundleAggregateAnalytics. Use CONSENT_CHANGED with NEW_VALUE/REGIME/PURPOSE for opt-in/out counts; SITE_SESSIONS or PAGE_VIEWS for total traffic. Requires ViewConsentManager API key scope.

metric.description: Analytics metric to query. CONSENT_CHANGED for opt-in/out counts; SITE_SESSIONS or PAGE_VIEWS for traffic totals.

start.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to `days` lookback from end.

days.description: Lookback window in days when start is omitted (default: 7).

include_dimensions.description: Dimension breakdowns (e.g. NEW_VALUE, REGIME, PURPOSE). Recommended for CONSENT_CHANGED.

tools.name: consent_get_timeseries_analytics
tools.description: Query timeseries consent analytics via airgapBundleTimeseriesAnalytics. Use PAGE_VIEWS or SITE_SESSIONS for traffic volume; SIGNAL_DETECTED for privacy signal counts. Requires ViewConsentManager API key scope.

metric.description: Analytics metric to query. PAGE_VIEWS for daily page-view volume; SITE_SESSIONS for sessions; SIGNAL_DETECTED for GPC/DNT signal counts over time.

start.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to `days` lookback from end.

days.description: Lookback window in days when start is omitted (default: 7).

tools.name: consent_get_analytics_data
tools.description: Query consent metrics via the analyticsData GraphQL query. Returns timeseries for privacy signals (DNT/GPC), consent changes (opt-in/out), or sessions by regime. Requires ViewConsentManager API key scope.

data_source.description: analyticsData source: PRIVACY_SIGNAL_TIMESERIES (DNT/GPC), CONSENT_CHANGES_TIMESERIES (opt-in/out), or CONSENT_SESSIONS_BY_REGIME.

start.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to `days` lookback from end.

days.description: Lookback window in days when start is omitted (default: 7).

bin.description: Time bin size for analyticsData (1h or 1d, default: 1d).

tools.name: consent_update_cookies
tools.description: Update one or more cookies. Use to approve (status=LIVE), junk (isJunk=true), assign tracking purposes, or set a service. The cookie "name" field is the identifier for upsert — existing cookies with matching names will be updated.

name.description: Cookie name (used as the identifier for upsert)

trackingPurposes.description: Tracking purpose slugs (e.g., "Advertising", "Analytics"). Pass an empty array to clear all purposes.

status.description: Set status to LIVE (approve) or NEEDS_REVIEW

tools.name: consent_update_data_flows
tools.description: Update one or more data flows. Use to approve (status=LIVE), junk (isJunk=true), assign tracking purposes, or set a service.

trackingPurposes.description: Tracking purpose slugs. Pass an empty array to clear all purposes.

status.description: Set status to LIVE (approve) or NEEDS_REVIEW

tools.name: consent_bulk_triage
tools.description: Bulk triage action: approve or junk multiple cookies and data flows in a single call. For cookies, APPROVE sets status=LIVE; JUNK sets isJunk=true. For data flows, same behavior. Optionally assign tracking purposes and service when approving.

id.description: Item ID (for data flows) or cookie name (for cookies)

action.description: Action to take: APPROVE or JUNK

trackingPurposes.description: Tracking purposes to assign (required when approving)

tools.name: consent_list_roc_records
tools.description: List all ROC records for a given user in a partition.

partition.description: The consent partition (airgap bundle id) the lookup is scoped to

identifierType.description: The type of the identifier to query: email, user_id, phone, etc.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-200); omit to return the full timeline

includeRawRequest.description: Whether to include the raw request in the response

tools.name: custom_functions_upsert
tools.description: Create or update a Custom Function from plaintext TypeScript. name/description apply immediately; code and runtime settings write a draft — run custom_functions_test_run { id }, then custom_functions_promote_version. Never pass secret values: use environmentVariables with isSecret true and dashboard fill-in. allowedHosts sets outbound domains (omit on update to keep). On create, omit sombraId and dataSiloId unless an error asks for them; use a unique name.

id.description: ID to update; omit to create

versionId.description: Pending draft to edit; omit to continue it (or start one from active). Requires id

type.description: Required on create (DSR or GENERAL). Inferred from the stored function on update

dataSiloId.description: Existing CUSTOM_FUNCTION silo that is still NOT_CONFIGURED (one DSR function per silo). Prefer omitting to auto-create one.

sombraId.description: Gateway ID; omit unless an error lists options. Never on DSR create

name.description: Required on create; keep unique for list search

description.description: Behavior description; applies immediately without creating a version

code.description: Plaintext TypeScript: export default async function ({ payload, environment }) and use global fetch. Required on create; on update omit to keep stored code (settings-only draft).

environmentVariables.description: Declare env vars with isSecret; merges with saved vars (use removeEnvironmentVariables to delete). Plain values may be set here; secrets are dashboard-only. Omit to leave env unchanged on update.

isSecret.description: When true, the user sets the value in the dashboard; never pass value. Plain to secret encrypts the current value; rotate it if sensitive

value.description: Plaintext only. Omit on update to keep the stored value. Never pass for secrets

removeEnvironmentVariables.description: Env var keys to delete on update; requires id

allowedHosts.description: Outbound hostname allowlist, no scheme. A provided list replaces the saved one. [] means localhost only; add 'localhost' for local sdk calls. On update, omit to keep the saved list.

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: custom_functions_list
tools.description: List Custom Functions (lifecycle, gateway, silo, versions). Search with text; check results before upsert when choosing a silo or gateway.

dataSiloId.description: Filter DSR functions by data silo ID

text.description: Filter by substring of name or description

tools.name: custom_functions_get_code
tools.description: Load plaintext TypeScript and runtime settings for editing (pending draft if any, else active). Pass versionId from the returned versions list to read any version. Returns settings and environmentVariables; secret values are never returned.

id.description: Custom function ID from list or upsert

versionId.description: Readable version ID; omit for preferred version (pending draft if any, else active)

tools.name: custom_functions_promote_version
tools.description: Promote a draft Custom Function version to active. Does not run tests; returns untestedWarning when the draft never passed custom_functions_test_run. Returns dependencyWarnings when follow-up may be needed.

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: custom_functions_test_run
tools.description: Test a Custom Function (saved or unsaved TypeScript). Pass { id } alone for the stored version (uses dashboard env); pass code for a trial without secrets. Prefer omitting payload. DSR or GENERAL. Logs mask all env var values, including plain ones.

id.description: Saved function ID; prefer alone after upsert. DSR stored runs bind Activity

type.description: Required without id (DSR or GENERAL). Inferred when id is set

code.description: Unsaved TypeScript trial; required without id. DSR also needs dataSiloId

payload.description: Omit to use type-specific defaults (recommended). Hand-built DSR payloads often fail with an unclear decode error.

payloadType.description: DSR only; defaults to DATA_POINT. Omit for GENERAL

sombraId.description: GENERAL gateway; omit with id unless an error lists options

dataSiloId.description: DSR silo; omit with id. Required for unsaved DSR tests

allowedHosts.description: Allowlist for unsaved code trials only. [] means localhost only.

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: preferences_list_partitions
tools.description: List Preference Store partition keys for this organization: the default airgap-bundle partition plus any custom consent partitions. partitions[].partition is the string to pass as `partition` on preferences_* tools — not the organization id. effectivePartition is the partition the consent manager currently uses; prefer the row with isEffectiveForConsentManager unless the user named another partition.

tools.name: preferences_query
tools.description: Query consent preferences for multiple users by their identifiers

partition.description: Preference Store partition key for the Sombra path. Call preferences_list_partitions first; use the returned partition string (bundle UUID or custom slug), not the organization id. Prefer the row with isEffectiveForConsentManager unless the user named another partition.

value.description: Identifier value. For name "phone", use E.164 (e.g. +14155550101), not national formats like +1-555-0101.

limit.description: Max records to return (1–50, defaults to identifier count)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous query

tools.name: preferences_upsert

value.description: Identifier value. For name "phone", use E.164 (e.g. +14155550101), not national formats like +1-555-0101.

enabled.description: Whether the purpose is enabled (Preference Store PUT /v1/preferences field name). Do not send "consent" — the API expects enabled: boolean.

options.description: Optional flags for upsert conflict handling

skipWorkflowTriggers.description: Skip consent workflow triggers/webhooks (use when testing).

tools.name: inventory_list_data_silos
tools.description: List data silos (data systems and integrations) in your organization. Pass `text` or `titles` to search/filter, or `customSiloConnectionStrategy=CUSTOM_FUNCTION` to find silos that can host a DSR Custom Function. Each row includes connectionState and customSiloConnectionStrategy; call inventory_get_data_silo for sombraId. `totalCount` is the full match count, not the size of this page.

text.description: Free-text search across data silos (GraphQL filterBy.text)

customSiloConnectionStrategy.description: Filter by connection strategy. CUSTOM_FUNCTION silos with connectionState=NOT_CONFIGURED can accept a new DSR Custom Function (one per silo)

tools.name: inventory_get_data_silo
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific data silo (Data Systems row): vendor link, silo-level processing purposes, owners, teams, business entities, data subjects (allowlist + blocklist), contact/website/notes metadata, identifiers, connectionState, customSiloConnectionStrategy, and sombraId. DSR Custom Functions attach only when strategy is CUSTOM_FUNCTION, sombraId is set, and connectionState is NOT_CONFIGURED (one function per silo). Use before inventory_write_data_silo to avoid overwriting existing assignments. For datapoints on this silo, call inventory_list_data_points with dataSiloId.

dataSiloId.description: ID of the data silo to retrieve

tools.name: inventory_list_catalog_integrations
tools.description: Search the Transcend integration catalog for valid `integrationName` values to pass to inventory_write_data_silo. Pass `text` to match title or integrationName (e.g. "salesforce"). `totalCount` is the full match count, not the size of this page.

text.description: Free-text search across catalog title and integrationName (GraphQL filterBy.text)

tools.name: inventory_write_data_silo
tools.description: Create or update a data silo (Data Systems table). Pass `dataSiloId` to update by ID, or `integrationName` to create (always creates — never upserts by title). For Custom Function integrations pass integrationName "customFunction" and sombraId. Optional metadata (owners, vendor, purposes, subjects, etc.) applies after create; if that patch fails the error includes `details.dataSiloId` — retry with `dataSiloId`, do not create again.

dataSiloId.description: Existing data silo ID. When set, updates that data system directly.

integrationName.description: Catalog integration name (GraphQL `name`), e.g. "server", "salesforce". Required when creating (dataSiloId omitted). Call inventory_list_catalog_integrations to search.

sombraId.description: Sombra gateway ID required when creating integrationName "customFunction". Reuse from custom_functions_list or inventory_get_data_silo.

title.description: Display title for the data silo

vendorId.description: Linked vendor ID from the Vendors table

processingPurposeSubCategoryIds.description: Silo-level purpose of processing IDs from inventory_list_processing_purposes

dataSubjectBlockListIds.description: Data subject IDs to block on this system (not an allowlist). Resolve via inventory_list_data_subjects.

isLive.description: Whether the data silo is live for DSR processing

tools.name: inventory_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (third-party data processors) with contact, website, DPA link, address, and headquarters fields. Pass `text` to search. `totalCount` is the full match count, not the size of this page.

tools.name: inventory_write_vendor
tools.description: Create or update a vendor in the Vendors table. Pass `vendorId` to update by ID, or `title` to upsert by title (creates when missing). Mirrors CLI inventory vendor sync.

vendorId.description: Existing vendor ID. When set, updates that vendor directly.

title.description: Vendor display title. Upsert key when vendorId is omitted; required to create a new vendor.

description.description: Vendor description (defaults to empty string on create)

dataProcessingAgreementLink.description: URL to the data processing agreement

tools.name: inventory_list_data_points
tools.description: List data points (collections of personal data). Pass `dataSiloId` to scope to one data system (recommended) and/or `text` to search. Each row includes `dataSiloId`. For field-level purposes/categories, follow up with inventory_list_sub_data_points.

dataSiloId.description: When set, only return datapoints belonging to this data silo (GraphQL filterBy.dataSilos). Strongly recommended for large inventories.

tools.name: inventory_update_or_create_data_point
tools.description: Create or update a datapoint (and its fields / sub-data points) on a data silo. Use this to assign purpose of processing on fields via `subDataPoints[].purposes` (`{ purpose, name }`, name defaults to "Other"). Mirrors GraphQL updateOrCreateDataPoint.

dataSiloId.description: ID of the parent data silo

name.description: Datapoint key / name (upsert key within the data silo)

subDataPoints.description: Field-level sub-data points. Purpose of processing is assigned here as `purposes: [{ purpose, name }]`.

name.description: Field name / key within the datapoint

purposes.description: Purpose of processing assignments for this field

categories.description: Data category assignments for this field

tools.name: inventory_list_sub_data_points
tools.description: List sub-data points (individual data fields) for a specific data point, including purpose of processing and data category assignments. Empty subcategory names are normalized to "Other".

dataPointId.description: ID of the parent data point

tools.name: inventory_list_identifiers
tools.description: List identifier types (email, user ID, etc.) configured in your organization. `totalCount` is the full match count, not the size of this page.

tools.name: inventory_list_categories
tools.description: List data category subcategories (PII types) from the Data Categories table. Each row includes `id`, `name`, `category`, and optional `description`. Optional `text` is a HAVING search over name, attributes, and DataCategoryType labels. Use these IDs or name+category pairs when assigning field-level categories via inventory_update_or_create_data_point.

text.description: Free-text search (GraphQL filterBy.text). This is a HAVING search over subcategory name, attributes, and matching DataCategoryType labels — not a simple ILIKE on name/description/category.

tools.name: inventory_write_category
tools.description: Create or update a data subcategory in the Data Categories table. Pass `id` to update by ID (name and category cannot change on update), or `name` + `category` to upsert (creates when missing). The unique key is name + category (e.g. "Email:CONTACT"). Use returned IDs when assigning categories via inventory_update_or_create_data_point.

id.description: Existing data subcategory ID. When set, updates that row directly.

name.description: Subcategory display name (e.g. "Other", "Email"). Upsert key with category when id is omitted.

category.description: Data category type (e.g. CONTACT, ID). Upsert key with name when id is omitted.

tools.name: inventory_list_processing_purposes
tools.description: List processing purpose subcategories from the Processing Purposes table in Data Inventory. Empty subcategory names are normalized to "Other" to match write-tool defaults. Use these IDs when assigning silo-level purposes via inventory_write_data_silo, or match `purpose`/`name` pairs when assigning field-level purposes via inventory_update_or_create_data_point.

text.description: Free-text search across processing purposes (GraphQL filterBy.text)

tools.name: inventory_write_processing_purpose
tools.description: Create or update a processing purpose subcategory in the Processing Purposes table. Pass `id` to update by ID, or `name` + `purpose` to upsert (creates when missing). The unique key is name + purpose (e.g. "Other:ESSENTIAL").

id.description: Existing processing purpose subcategory ID. When set, updates that row directly.

name.description: Subcategory display name (e.g. "Other", "Login"). Upsert key with purpose when id is omitted.

purpose.description: Processing purpose enum (e.g. ESSENTIAL, ANALYTICS). Upsert key with name when id is omitted.

tools.name: inventory_list_business_entities
tools.description: List business entities from Data Inventory. Use `title` values with inventory_write_data_silo `businessEntityTitles`.

tools.name: inventory_list_data_subjects
tools.description: List data subject types configured for the organization. Use `id` values with inventory_write_data_silo `dataSubjectBlockListIds` (IDs of subjects to *block* from the data system — inverse of an allowlist). Returns the full set (not paginated).

tools.name: inventory_analyze
tools.description: Analyze your data inventory including data silos by type, vendor distribution, and data point coverage

tools.name: discovery_classify_text
tools.description: Classify text content using Transcend's LLM classifier to identify data categories. Requires at least one category label.

texts.description: Array of text strings to classify

categories.description: Category labels to classify against (required). Common PII labels include EMAIL, PHONE, NAME, IP_ADDRESS, LOCATION, and NOT_PERSONAL_DATA.

model.description: LLM model type override (sent as model_type)

tools.name: discovery_ner_extract
tools.description: Extract named entities (PII, organizations, locations, etc.) from text using NER. Requires at least one entity type label.

entityTypes.description: Entity type labels to extract (required). Examples: Contact, Email, Phone, IP Address, Not Personal Data.

tools.name: discovery_list_scans
tools.description: List data silos as classification scan records. Each row describes a silo rather than a real scan run, so `status` is not a live scan state; use `inventory_list_data_silos` when you want the silos themselves.

tools.name: discovery_list_plugins
tools.description: List the integration types in use in your organization, derived from the distinct types of the data silos on this page. Because the set is derived per page rather than queried directly, union the results across pages for a complete list.

tools.name: assessments_list
tools.description: List all assessments in your organization. Surface the `url` on each row verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

statuses.description: Lifecycle statuses to include. Omit for every status.

text.description: Free-text match on the assessment title

ids.description: Specific assessment form IDs to fetch

assigneeIds.description: Transcend user IDs the form is assigned to. Resolve names with `admin_list_users`.

reviewerIds.description: Transcend user IDs reviewing the form. Resolve names with `admin_list_users`.

assessmentGroupIds.description: Groups the forms belong to; see `assessments_list_groups`

createdAfter.description: Only forms created strictly after this date

createdBefore.description: Only forms created on or before this date

dueAfter.description: Only forms due strictly after this date

dueBefore.description: Only forms due on or before this date. Use for overdue.

sortBy.description: Column to sort on; the API offers no creation-date sort. Omit for its default order.

includeDetails.description: Also return assignees, reviewers, due/updated/submitted dates and lock state.

tools.name: assessments_get
tools.description: Read one filled-in assessment and the answers submitted to it. Given only assessmentId it returns the section list with a question count each, NOT the question text. To read the questions, either pass questionText to get just the ones on a topic wherever they sit, or sectionIds to expand whole sections; every sectionId must exist or the call fails, and reading the form in full means passing every one of them. Reviewer feedback is counted here but read with assessments_list_comments. Surface the returned `url` verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment form to read. Call assessments_list to look one up by title or status.

sectionIds.description: Expand these sections, returning their questions, answer options and submitted answers in full. Omit on the first call: you get the section list back and pick from it. A whole form can run to hundreds of questions, far more than fits in one response.

questionText.description: Return only the questions whose text matches this, with their answers, instead of whole sections. Use it to answer whether a form covers a topic — "retention", "third party" — without guessing which section holds it. Combine with sectionIds to search inside those sections.

tools.name: assessments_create
tools.description: Create a new privacy assessment inside an assessment group, resolved by name through assessments_list_groups. Surface the returned `url` verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentGroupId.description: Group to create the assessment in. Find it by name with assessments_list_groups. If no group is built from the template you want, create one with assessments_create_group rather than guessing at an existing group.

assigneeIds.description: User IDs to assign the assessment to. Assign here rather than later: a new form is DRAFT, and a DRAFT form rejects answers. Assigning it moves it to SHARED, where it can be answered.

tools.name: assessments_create_group
tools.description: Create a new assessment group linked to a template. Assessment groups are containers for assessments. Surface the returned `groupUrl` verbatim.

templateId.description: ID of the assessment template to link this group to

reviewerIds.description: IDs of users assigned to review new assessments in this group (optional)

tools.name: assessments_list_groups
tools.description: List all assessment groups. Groups are containers for assessments and are linked to templates. Use this to find the right group ID for creating assessments. To reach the template behind a form, pass its `assessmentGroupId` as `ids` and read `assessmentFormTemplate`. Surface the `groupUrl` on each row verbatim.

text.description: Free-text match on the group title and description

ids.description: Specific group IDs, e.g. the `assessmentGroupId` on an `assessments_list` row

templateIds.description: Groups built from these templates; see `assessments_list_templates`

tools.name: assessments_list_comments
tools.description: Read the reviewer feedback on one assessment — the comments left on it during review. Returns feedback from all three levels at once, whether it was left on the form as a whole, on a section, or on a single question, each row naming what it sits on. Resolution is per thread on the root comment (no parentCommentId); replies close when that root is resolved. Narrow with levels, authorIds, and resolution (OPEN/RESOLVED/ALL). Use this rather than assessments_get, which only counts feedback. To reply or resolve a thread, call assessments_write_comment with the root id, level, and targetId.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment form whose feedback you want. Call assessments_list to look one up by title or status.

authorIds.description: Only comments written by these people. Call admin_list_users to turn a name or email into an id, or assessments_list with includeDetails to see who is reviewing a form. Omit for every author.

resolution.description: OPEN / RESOLVED filter by the root of each thread (the row with no parentCommentId). A reply is open only while its root is unresolved — replies are not resolved on their own. ALL returns both. Default OPEN.

levels.description: Only feedback left at these levels: FORM for the assessment as a whole, SECTION for one of its sections, QUESTION for a single question. Use QUESTION for "what did reviewers say about the answers". Omit for every level.

tools.name: assessments_write_comment
tools.description: Leave, reply to, edit, or resolve reviewer feedback on an assessment — form, section, or question. Resolution is per thread on the root comment (no parentCommentId); replies close when that root is resolved. Pass parentCommentId to reply, commentId to edit or resolve a root, or reply with resolved true to close the parent thread. Needs the comment id, level, and target id from existing reviewer feedback on the assessment.

assessmentId.description: Assessment form id (from assessments_list). Dashboard link; FORM edit/resolve defaults targetId to this when omitted.

content.description: Comment body. Required to create or reply; omit when only resolving via commentId.

level.description: FORM, SECTION, or QUESTION — from the assessments_list_comments row.

targetId.description: Form, section, or question id (list row targetId). Required to create/reply; required for QUESTION edit/resolve; FORM defaults to assessmentId.

parentCommentId.description: Root comment to reply to. Not with commentId. With resolved true, closes that parent thread after the reply (replies are not resolved on their own).

commentId.description: Existing comment to edit and/or resolve (id from assessments_list_comments). To resolve a thread, pass the root id (the row with no parentCommentId), not a reply.

resolved.description: true to resolve the thread, false to reopen. Needs the root commentId, or parentCommentId when replying (closes that parent). Replies are not resolved alone.

tools.name: assessments_update
tools.description: Update an existing assessment. Surface the returned `url` verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment to update

reviewerIds.description: IDs of users assigned to review this assessment

tools.name: assessments_list_templates
tools.description: List the blank assessment templates. Only `PUBLISHED` ones can build new assessments.

text.description: Free-text match on the template title and description

statuses.description: Publication statuses to include. Omit for both.

tools.name: assessments_update_assignees
tools.description: Assign internal users (by ID) or external users (by email) to an assessment form. This also transitions DRAFT assessments to SHARED status.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment form to update assignees for

assigneeIds.description: Array of internal user IDs to assign to the assessment

externalAssigneeEmails.description: Array of external email addresses to assign to the assessment

tools.name: assessments_answer_question
tools.description: Answer an assessment question by selecting existing answer options or providing free-text values. For SINGLE_SELECT/MULTI_SELECT questions, provide assessmentAnswerIds from the answerOptions. For SHORT_ANSWER_TEXT/LONG_ANSWER_TEXT, provide assessmentAnswerValues with {value, isUserCreated: true}.

assessmentQuestionId.description: ID of the assessment question to answer

assessmentAnswerIds.description: IDs of existing answer options to select (for SINGLE_SELECT/MULTI_SELECT questions)

assessmentAnswerValues.description: Free-text answer values to create and select (for text questions). Each item: {value: string, isUserCreated: boolean}

value.description: The free-text answer content to record for the question.

isUserCreated.description: True when this value is newly authored by the caller (rather than an existing option). Use true for free-text answers.

tools.name: assessments_submit_response
tools.description: Submit an assessment form for review. Optionally specify which sections to submit. This transitions the assessment toward the IN_REVIEW status. The returned `url` points at the assessment-group page where reviewers find the submitted form — surface it verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment to submit for review

assessmentSectionIds.description: Array of section IDs to submit for review. Required by the API.

tools.name: assessments_create_template
tools.description: Create a new assessment form template with sections and questions inline. This is the "import" side of the JSON import/export workflow. You can provide the full template structure (sections with questions and answer options) in a single call. Question types: LONG_ANSWER_TEXT, SHORT_ANSWER_TEXT, SINGLE_SELECT, MULTI_SELECT, FILE. SubTypes: NONE, CUSTOM, USER, TEAM, DATA_SUB_CATEGORY, HAS_PERSONAL_DATA, ATTRIBUTE_KEY, SENSITIVE_CATEGORY. Auto-corrections: referenceId is auto-generated as UUID if missing or not UUID format; subType is auto-set to CUSTOM when allowSelectOther is true; requireRiskEvaluation is ignored when no riskFrameworkId is provided.

title.description: Title of the assessment form template

status.description: Template status: DRAFT or PUBLISHED (default: DRAFT)

sections.description: Array of section objects with title and optional questions array

tools.name: assessments_add_section
tools.description: Add a new section (with optional inline questions) to an existing assessment form template. Useful for building templates incrementally or adding sections to imported templates. Same auto-corrections as assessments_create_template apply to questions.

templateId.description: ID of the assessment form template to add the section to

questions.description: Array of question objects: [{title, type, subType?, description?, placeholder?, isRequired?, referenceId?, answerOptions?: [{value}], allowSelectOther?, requireRiskEvaluation?}]

tools.name: assessments_export_template
tools.description: Export a full assessment form template as JSON, including all sections, questions, answer options, and configuration. This is the "export" side of the JSON import/export workflow. The output can be used as input for assessments_create_template to recreate the template elsewhere.

templateId.description: ID of the assessment form template to export

tools.name: assessments_prefill
tools.description: Create an assessment form, fill in the answers you supply, and assign it for review in one call. Combines: create form → assign it → read its questions → answer each → optionally submit. Requires assigneeIds or assigneeEmails: a form accepts no answers until it is assigned. The answers are yours to provide; nothing is generated for you. Surface the returned `url` verbatim.

title.description: Title for the new assessment form

assessmentGroupId.description: Group to create the form in. Find it by name with assessments_list_groups. If no group is built from the template you want, create one with assessments_create_group rather than guessing at an existing group.

answers.description: Map of answers keyed by question title or referenceId, both of which come from assessments_export_template on the template you are creating from. Prefer referenceId; it survives rewording. A string for text and single-select, an array for multi-select. Select values are matched against the question answerOptions, so copy those exactly where they fit. A question holds at most one written-in answer, so values matching no option are joined into a single one and are stored together rather than separately selectable. Where a question allows no written-in answer they are not stored at all and come back under missedOptionValues. Prefilling never edits the shared template. Keep SHORT_ANSWER_TEXT under 255 characters.

assigneeIds.description: Internal user IDs to assign before prefilling. Provide this or assigneeEmails so the form can leave DRAFT.

assigneeEmails.description: External email addresses to assign before prefilling. Provide this or assigneeIds so the form can leave DRAFT. They can answer but cannot submit, so submitForReview also needs assigneeIds.

reviewerIds.description: User IDs to set as reviewers (optional)

includeDetails.description: When true, include one result row per question. Default false returns compact counts.

submitForReview.description: Whether to automatically submit the form for review after prefilling (default: false)

tools.name: workflows_list
tools.description: List workflow configs in your organization. Use each returned `id` as `workflowConfigId` for `dsr_submit`. Results include `actionType` and `subjectType` so you can pick ACCESS vs ERASURE (and subject class) without guessing.

tools.name: workflows_update_config
tools.description: Update the configuration for a workflow. Supported fields: title, subtitle, description. Note: privacy-center visibility is controlled by the workflow config's visibility tier and is not editable through this tool.

workflowConfigId.description: ID of the workflow config to update (use workflows_list to find config IDs)

tools.name: workflows_list_email_templates
tools.description: List all email templates used in workflows and communications.

tools.name: policy_get_templates
tools.description: List Policy Engine starter templates (no args) or return scaffold files (templateId). ActivatePolicyEngineBundles covers all policy tools — do not create separate API keys per operation.

templateId.description: Return scaffold files only for this template. Omit for the template list.

tools.name: policy_list_bundles
tools.description: Discover Policy Engine bundles, version history, and download URLs. Mirrors transcend policy bundles / versions / download. Requires View Policy scope (included in Activate scope).

versionId.description: When set with a bundle, returns that version metadata and downloadUrl

cursor.description: Cursor for version history pagination (from a prior policy_list_bundles response)

tools.name: policy_publish
tools.description: Upload an inert Policy Engine version from files (in-memory map) or dir. Not live until policy_set_live activate. Requires Manage Policy scope (included in Activate).

dir.description: Local directory with .manifest + .rego (mutually exclusive with files)

files.description: Relative path → file contents (.manifest + .rego). Same map as policy_get_templates scaffold output. Mutually exclusive with dir.

description.description: Optional description for the uploaded version

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: policy_set_live
tools.description: Explicit go-live or take-offline step after policy_publish. action "activate" makes a version live; "deactivate" clears the active version. Mirrors transcend policy activate / deactivate. Requires Activate Policy scope.

action.description: Whether to go live or take offline

bundleName.description: Tenant-unique bundle name (required unless bundleId is set)

versionId.description: Version UUID to activate (required for activate unless version label is set)

version.description: Version label to activate (alternative to versionId)

approvalToken.description: Approval token from a previous confirmation_required response for this exact call. Omit it on the first call. Only send it back after the user has agreed to the pending action; it is single-use and expires shortly.

tools.name: admin_get_organization
tools.description: Get information about your Transcend organization

tools.name: admin_get_current_user
tools.description: Get information about the currently authenticated user (the API key owner)

tools.name: admin_list_users
tools.description: List users in your Transcend organization with the same filters as Administration → Users. text searches name and email (case-insensitive substring). Team filters need UUIDs — call admin_list_teams then pass teamIds. scopeNames / derivedScopeNames use ScopeName values from admin_list_scopes. Default sort is name ASC.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring search across user name OR email (ILIKE). There are no separate name/email filter fields.

isAdmin.description: Filter to organization administrators only when true

isInvited.description: Filter to invited (not yet onboarded) users when true

isLocked.description: Filter to account-locked users when true

canRevealMultiTenantSombraSecret.description: Filter by whether the user can reveal the multi-tenant Sombra secret

teamIds.description: Filter to users on these team UUIDs. Resolve team names to IDs with admin_list_teams first.

scopeNames.description: Filter by directly assigned ScopeName values. Call admin_list_scopes for valid names.

derivedScopeNames.description: Filter by derived ScopeName values (teams, dependencies, admins). Call admin_list_scopes.

orderField.description: Field to sort by (default: name). One of name, createdAt, updatedAt

orderDirection.description: Sort direction ASC or DESC (default: ASC, matching Admin Users)

tools.name: admin_list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in your Transcend organization.

tools.name: admin_list_api_keys
tools.description: List all API keys configured for your organization (tokens are not shown).

tools.name: admin_list_scopes
tools.description: List valid ScopeName values for API keys and user permissions. Default rows are compact (name, title, type, dependencies). Filter with text; set includeDetails only when titles are not enough.

text.description: Case-insensitive filter over scope name, title, and description.

includeDetails.description: When true, add description and products. Default false returns compact rows.

tools.name: admin_get_privacy_center
tools.description: Get privacy center configuration for your organization

tools.name: admin_test_connection
tools.description: Test connectivity to both Transcend REST and GraphQL APIs

instructions: For how-to, product concepts, setup guides, or "what is X" questions about Transcend (e.g. airgap, consent, DSR): (1) call docs_list with the most distinctive terms for the topic (full-text over titles and article bodies), (2) call docs_fetch on the best matching URL, (3) answer from that content. API tools return data from the signed-in organization; they do not replace product documentation.
